EXTEIRE CONTRACT AVAILABLE ON PROMIS SYSTEM For Metro Use Only Number: 15452 Date: JAN 2 8 2005 CONTRACT BETWEEN METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY AND PROFESSIONAL ADJUSTMENT SERVICES, INC. FOR THE PURCHASE OF SERVICES This contract is entered into on this day of , , by and between THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY, a municipal corporation of the State of Tennessee (‘Metro") and Professional Adjustment Services, Inc., 450 Tenth Circle North, Nashville, TN 37203 (‘Contractor’). This contract consists of the following documents: This document, Request for Proposal (RFP) #03-129, Addendum #1, dated September 22, 2003, Addendum #2, dated September 22, 2003 Proposal, and Insurance Requirements In the event of conflicting provisions, all documents shall be construed according to the following priorities: e Any properly executed amendment or change order to this contract (most recent with first priority), This contract, RFP #03-129, Addendum #1, dated September 22, 2003, Addendum #2, dated September 22, 2003, Proposal, and Certificate of Insurance
1. Duties and Responsibilities of Contractor. Contractor agrees to provide and Metro agrees to purchase the following services: Collection Services in accordance with the terms, conditions, and specification stated in the stated RFP and incorporated herein by reference, and the Proposal incorporated herein by reference. ARCHIVE
